name: Unternehmenswebseite / Premium-Website
summary: Marken- und Unternehmenswebseite auf Agenturniveau: Designsystem, Motion, Hero-Video, Referenzen, CMS für die Redaktion, Mehrsprachigkeit, SEO, Barrierefreiheit, DSGVO und ein hartes Performance-Budget.

roles.name: Redaktion
roles.can: Seiten, Referenzen, Artikel und Stellen im CMS pflegen, Vorschau, veröffentlichen

modules.name: Seiten & Navigation
features: Start, Leistungen, Über uns, Kontakt mit echten Texten (keine Platzhalter)
Klare Navigation mit Call-to-Action, mobiles Menü

criteria.title: Mobile menu opens and reaches every main page
expected: URL is /leistungen
Heading 'Leistungen' is visible
The menu is closed after navigation

modules.name: Kontakt & Leads
features: E-Mail an das Unternehmen und Bestätigung an den Absender

criteria.title: Valid contact request shows a thank-you and e-mails the company
steps: Fill Name 'Lena Berg', E-Mail 'lena@example.com', Nachricht 'Wir planen einen Relaunch'
expected: Text 'Danke, Lena' is visible
Outbox contains a mail to the company with 'Wir planen einen Relaunch'
Outbox contains a confirmation to lena@example.com

criteria.title: Submission with a filled honeypot is dropped silently
steps: POST /api/contact with a filled hidden field 'website'
expected: Status 200
No lead is stored and no mail is sent

modules.name: Recht & Consent (DSGVO)
features: Impressum und Datenschutzerklärung von jeder Seite erreichbar
Cookie-Consent: Analyse und Marketing erst nach Zustimmung

criteria.title: No analytics request or cookie before consent, loaded after 'Alle akzeptieren'
expected: Before consent: no request to the analytics endpoint and no analytics cookie
After consent: the analytics script is loaded

criteria.title: Footer of every page links Impressum and Datenschutz
steps: Visit every page of the sitemap
expected: Each footer has links 'Impressum' and 'Datenschutz' that return 200

modules.name: SEO & Teilen
features: Eigener Title und Description pro Seite

criteria.title: Every page has its own title, description and og:image; sitemap lists them
steps: Open every URL from the sitemap
expected: Titles are unique
Each page has meta description and og:image
The sitemap contains every public page

criteria.title: Unknown URL shows the designed 404 page
expected: Status 404
Text 'Seite nicht gefunden' and a link to the homepage are visible

modules.name: Designsystem
features: Komponenten: Hero, Feature-Grid, Testimonials, Logo-Wall, CTA-Band, Zahlen, FAQ
Art Direction: Bildsprache, Illustration oder 3D-Akzente konsistent

criteria.title: Design review: every page uses the tokens and type scale, no ad-hoc colours or sizes
steps: grep the styles for hex colours and px font sizes outside the token file
expected: No values outside the tokens
Consistent spacing rhythm on every page

modules.name: Motion & Interaktion
features: prefers-reduced-motion schaltet Animationen und Autoplay ab

criteria.title: With reduced motion all content is visible at once and nothing autoplays
steps: Open / and scroll to the bottom
expected: No element below the fold has opacity 0
The hero video is paused and shows its poster

modules.name: Hero-Video & Filme
features: Stummes Hero-Loop-Video aus eigenem Material oder Bildern geschnitten (video-producer)
Lazy-Loading für Videos unterhalb des sichtbaren Bereichs

criteria.title: Hero video is muted, inline, has a poster and WebM + MP4 sources
expected: Attributes muted, playsinline and poster are set
Sources include video/webm and video/mp4
The poster image loads with status 200

modules.name: Referenzen
features: Detailseiten: Ausgangslage, Lösung, messbare Ergebnisse, Zitat

criteria.title: Filtering by industry narrows the list and a card opens its case study
expected: Only cards with industry 'Industrie' remain
Detail page shows heading, 'Ergebnisse' and at least one figure

modules.name: CMS für die Redaktion
features: Headless CMS (z. B. Payload oder Sanity) oder Admin mit Entwurf/Vorschau/Veröffentlichen
Seiten, Referenzen, Artikel ohne Entwickler pflegbar

criteria.title: Editor changes the homepage headline, previews it and publishes
steps: Edit the hero headline to 'Wir bauen Zukunft'
expected: The preview shows the new headline
After publishing, / shows 'Wir bauen Zukunft' to visitors

criteria.title: Published article appears in the list, its page and the RSS feed
expected: The article page shows title, author and reading time
rss.xml contains the article

criteria.title: Language switch on a subpage leads to the same page in English
expected: URL is /en/services
html lang is 'en'
Head contains hreflang links for de and en

modules.name: Performance-Budget
features: LCP ≤ 2,5 s, CLS ≤ 0,1 auf allen Seiten
Bilder in AVIF/WebP mit responsiven Größen, Fonts preload + swap
Kein Layout-Shift durch Bilder, Fonts, Consent-Banner

criteria.title: UI tour reports no performance budget violation on any page
expected: No 'performance budget' issue in .onecommand/tour/report.md

criteria.title: axe finds no serious or critical violations on the main pages
expected: 0 violations with impact serious or critical

criteria.title: First Tab press focuses 'Zum Inhalt springen'
expected: Focused element has text 'Zum Inhalt springen' and a visible focus ring

modules.name: Seitenbaukasten
features: Redaktion baut Landingpages aus Blöcken (Hero, Grid, Zahlen, Testimonials, CTA, Video)
Block-Varianten aus dem Designsystem, keine freien Styles

criteria.title: Editor composes a landing page from blocks and publishes it at its slug
steps: Create page 'Messe 2027' with blocks Hero, Zahlen, CTA
expected: /messe-2027 shows the three blocks in that order
The page appears in sitemap.xml

modules.name: Imagefilm & Videothek
features: Imagefilm und Produktfilme mit Ton, Untertiteln (VTT) und Kapiteln

criteria.title: Image film plays with German captions on by default
steps: Click play on the image film
expected: The video has controls and a captions track with srclang 'de' marked default
Playback starts (currentTime > 0 after 2 s)

modules.name: Karriere
features: Stellenanzeigen aus dem CMS mit JobPosting-Strukturdaten

criteria.title: Application with a PDF CV is accepted and confirmed
steps: Fill name and e-mail, upload cv.pdf
expected: Text 'Bewerbung eingegangen' is visible
Outbox contains a confirmation to the applicant

criteria.title: Upload of a non-PDF or a file over 10 MB is rejected
expected: Status 422 with a message for each

criteria.title: Subscription is active only after the confirmation link
steps: Open the link from the outbox mail
expected: Before the link: status pending
After the link: 'Anmeldung bestätigt' and status confirmed

modules.name: Seitensuche
features: Suche über Seiten, Referenzen, Artikel und Stellen

criteria.title: Search finds a case study and an article by keyword
expected: Results contain the case study and the article with 'Relaunch' highlighted

modules.name: Lead-Weiterleitung
features: Leads per Webhook an CRM (z. B. HubSpot, Pipedrive, eigenes CRM)

criteria.title: Contact request is forwarded to the CRM webhook with its UTM source
expected: One POST with name, e-mail, message and utm_source 'linkedin'

criteria.title: CI fails when a Lighthouse budget or a visual snapshot regresses
expected: A Lighthouse CI job with budgets for performance ≥ 95, accessibility ≥ 95, SEO = 100
Playwright screenshot comparison for /, /leistungen, /kontakt

non_functional.text: Keine Platzhaltertexte, Lorem ipsum oder Stockfoto-Wasserzeichen; jeder Text ist für das Unternehmen geschrieben
Responsive von 360 px bis 2560 px; keine horizontale Scrollbar
Statisch generiert oder gecacht (SSG/ISR); TTFB unter 200 ms aus dem CDN
Bilder: AVIF/WebP, responsive srcset, Alt-Text Pflicht im CMS, Lizenz/Credit je Medium
Lighthouse ≥ 95 in Performance, Barrierefreiheit, Best Practices; SEO = 100
Visuelle Abnahme: jede Seite einzeln im Screenshot-Review des UI-Rundgangs freigegeben
